meta.sampling: Year × month stratified world sample (~16/month). No continent filter. Same validation/dedupe as Barn Swallow. No fabricated records; not migration tracks.
meta.disclaimer: Points are occurrence records, not individual migration tracks or confirmed breeding sites. Density reflects sampling effort.
meta.flockScaling: Visible dots = log-scaled GBIF year×month coordinate count, clamped to 10–100. Shared domain across species.
